justifications.durability: The marker is a durable machine-readable block written beside the value it annotates, so a reader sees the retirement without leaving the file, and the driver is idempotent (an existing dimensions_provenance block is preserved rather than replaced). The repair strengthens the completeness statement by emitting marked/unmarked counts per swept value rather than a bare target count. Held below full for the inherited limitations: there is still no guard that a later edit cannot silently drop the marker, no negative control falsifies the marker's presence (the reviewed run's write paths contain no test file and it declared none), the completeness test is a substring rather than a structural check, and nothing exercises a downstream consumer of the marker.
